derived_metrics.profile_visit_rate: profile_visits / non_follower_reach when available; otherwise profile_visits / reach

zero_division_rule: Return null, not zero, when denominator is zero or unavailable.
comparison_rule: Do not compare raw counts across platforms as if exposure were equal. Prefer normalized rates and within-platform baselines.

winner_rule_v1.minimum: At least one primary growth metric materially above the same-platform rolling baseline without a material brand/quality failure.
winner_rule_v1.replication_requirement: A single outlier can trigger fast-follow content but does not change strategy until repeated evidence exists.
